$comment: Expected vision-reader transcription for a sharp, straight-on photo of the printed CTN-13 label (CTN-13-label.pdf in this folder). Field names match the carton read prompt in Gate.Agent/DockImagePipeline.cs (ReadPrompt); values mirror the printed lines. read_confidence is model-reported and has no fixed value; expect a high value on a clean photo. The damage fields describe the carton in the photo, not the label.
